problem: Let $u=[\begin{aligned}k \\ -5 \\ -1 \\ -k\end{aligned}]$ and $v=[\begin{aligned}k \\ k \\ 3 \\ -3\end{aligned}]$ be vectors such that  $u⊥v.$ Find the value of $k.$

examples.problem: If ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14044739/assets/16e82b08842bdec1de657e14110b08037cca4452d1f0e8c64a8fd783037adeb6.png) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14044739/assets/559785dc3071ba5018f9b97d45e18e9f7bf937f702f9eeaf0a9c5ae087d5b43f.png) are orthogonal vectors, find the value of $k.$
examples.worked_solution:
Since $\mathbf{u}$ and $\mathbf{v}$ are orthogonal vectors, we have that their dot product is equal to zero.
First, let's calculate the dot product in terms of $k$:

$$
\begin{aligned}u\cdot v & ={u}_{1}\cdot {v}_{1}+{u}_{2}\cdot {v}_{2}+{u}_{3}\cdot {v}_{3}+{u}_{4}\cdot {v}_{4} \\  & =5\cdot (-4)+(-3)\cdot 6+k\cdot (-6)+(-2)\cdot 8 \\  & =-20-18-6k-16 \\  & =-6k-54.\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the last line to zero, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}-6k-54 & =0 \\ -6k & =54 \\ k & =-9.\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.problem:
Given the vector $u=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 1 \\ 8 \\ -3\end{aligned}]$, which of the following vectors are orthogonal to $u?$

$$
v=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -7 \\ 2 \\ 5\end{aligned}],\,w=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ -5 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 1 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
We compute the dot product between $u$ and each of the listed vectors:

$$
\begin{aligned}u\cdot v & ={u}_{1}\cdot {v}_{1}+{u}_{2}\cdot {v}_{2}+{u}_{3}\cdot {v}_{3}+{u}_{4}\cdot {v}_{4} \\  & =(-5)\cdot (-1)+1\cdot (-7)+8\cdot 2+(-3)\cdot 5 \\  & =5-7+16-15 \\  & =-1.\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}u\cdot w & ={u}_{1}\cdot {w}_{1}+{u}_{2}\cdot {w}_{2}+{u}_{3}\cdot {w}_{3}+{u}_{4}\cdot {w}_{4} \\  & =(-5)\cdot (-3)+1\cdot (-5)+8\cdot (-1)+(-3)\cdot 2 \\  & =15-5-8-6 \\  & =-4.\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}u\cdot x & ={u}_{1}\cdot {x}_{1}+{u}_{2}\cdot {x}_{2}+{u}_{3}\cdot {x}_{3}+{u}_{4}\cdot {x}_{4} \\  & =(-5)\cdot 1+1\cdot (-1)+8\cdot 1+(-3)\cdot 4 \\  & =-5-1+8-12 \\  & =-10.\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

Consequently, the correct option is 'None of the listed'.
